people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: His servants carried him in a chariot to Jerusalem, and buried him in his tomb with his fathers in David’s city.
translations.bsb: Then his servants carried him by chariot to Jerusalem and buried him with his fathers in his tomb in the City of David.
translations.kjv: And his servants carried him in a chariot to Jerusalem, and buried him in his sepulchre with his fathers in the city of David.
translations.asv: And his servants carried him in a chariot to Jerusalem, and buried him in his sepulchre with his fathers in the city of David.
